source_title: UNICEF WHO and Gavi oral cholera vaccine supply recovery
unit_or_scope: global oral cholera vaccine supply and preventive campaigns in Mozambique after floods
direct_observation: Annual global oral cholera vaccine supply nearly doubled from 35 million doses in 2022 to nearly 70 million in 2025; preventive campaigns resumed after more than three years and Mozambique restarted amid floods affecting over 700000 people
closed_stage: supply expansion allocation and campaign restart
missing_stage: local production attribution completed vaccination household protection immunity and sustained affordability
evidence_status: official UNICEF WHO Gavi announcement; supply and campaign launch evidence without patient-level completion
next_test: follow doses from allocation to vaccination receipt coverage and protection in flood-affected communities

source_title: WHO Africa Health Observatory Nigeria medical products profile
unit_or_scope: approximately 150 Nigerian local pharmaceutical manufacturers and national distribution system
direct_observation: Local manufacturers meet about 30 percent of national needs; storage deterioration stock shortages and fake products persist while third-party logistics have reduced some stockouts; weak electricity temperature monitoring vehicles and information systems constrain distribution
closed_stage: named local-capacity and last-mile risk case
missing_stage: product-level quality facility receipt affordability patient confidence rural continuity and health outcome
evidence_status: official 2025 WHO profile updated 2026; system-level evidence with no product/patient ledger
next_test: trace one essential medicine batch through manufacturer warehouse logistics facility dispensing and patient use
